maximal_clique.note: Inclusion-maximal clique: S is a clique and no proper superset is a clique (maxset cliqueb). Not maximum cardinality; the empty set qualifies only in K_0, and singletons are maximal exactly at isolated vertices.

nontrivial_maximal_clique.note: Inclusion-maximal clique with at least two vertices (1 < #|S|); in the disjoint K_2 + K_3 both sides qualify while only K_3 is maximum.
